name: Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A.
summary: Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A. produces and sells sugar and derivatives under the Iansa brand name in Chile. It is also involved in the production of industrial and retail sugar, non-caloric sweeteners, and sugar production byproducts; animal nutrition business; sale agricultural inputs, such as urea fertilizers; and production and sale of tomato paste, and fruit juices and pulps. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Santiago, Chile. Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of E.D.& F. Man Chile Ltda.
